namespaces.name: uk
namespaces.description: UK tax/NI thresholds, Bank of England Bank Rate, UK car tax (VED) and MOT rules, UK exam dates and UK government service steps, fees and processing times
namespaces.cadence: uk-rates: Every 6 April (new tax year) and after each Budget or Autumn Statement; minimum wage on 1 April; every source page re-fetched weekly. policy-rates: After each scheduled decision (eight a year per bank); re-verified within 45 days of verifiedDate; every source page re-fetched weekly. uk-vehicle-rules: Every 1 April (VED rates and the historic-vehicle exemption date move with the Finance Act) and after each Budget; MOT fees and rules when DVSA changes them; every source page re-fetched weekly. uk-exam-dates: Annual, calendar-driven: when JCQ and the boards publish the following summer's final timetables (early in the calendar year) and the results days; the weekly watcher hashes the JCQ and board timetable pages uk-gov-process: Re-verified against the gov.uk pages every 30 days and on fee-change days (Home Office fees usually move in April); every source page re-fetched weekly through the gov.uk content API.
